family_dispositions.reason: Full discovered Hero identity roster retained and enriched with structured skill/stat facts where inspectable.

All 34 current Heroes have structured skill ladders: the pinned inspectable GitHub dataset covers Gen 1-5 and maintained source-locked Hero pages complete Gen 6-7. Expressive guide prose and recommendations are excluded.
All 34 maintained Hero pages expose a 31-row star-stat/shard progression table (1,054 rows total); the open shard reference is retained as corroborating structured data.
Open level/XP/deployment-capacity table imported.
All 34 Hero identities are classified; 22 Heroes expose complete 10-level Exclusive Weapon tables (220 rows) and non-exclusive Heroes remain explicitly non-applicable rather than missing.
Quality/Mastery ladder retained and factual Hero-page Gear tables imported where published.
Complete open per-step material/bonus/power/confidence ladder imported.
Open per-level Charm table imported; historical maintained-source max-level conflict remains visible.
Named ratios remain sourced non-recommendation conventions.

All 12 maintained Building entities are represented with their complete structured factual tables; open Building/Truegold feeds corroborate those entities rather than being double-counted as extra Buildings.
Open troop tier/cost/time/points table imported with source terminology preserved.

All 191 maintained Academy technology identities and all 714 visible per-level rows are imported. Fortified Mail VI declares Max Level 6 but publishes no level table; its six level values remain explicit unknowns.
Open War Academy technology feed imported with per-level resources/Truegold Dust/time/effects.
All 60 maintained Alliance Technology identities and all 279 visible level rows are imported with costs, donations, bar, time, effect and requirements.
All 14 maintained Pet detail pages are represented and every structured factual table published on those pages is retained; genuinely unpublished fields remain unknown.

All 6 maintained Master entities are represented with every published structured Affinity/skill/material/research table; the open Master feed is corroborating data rather than additional game entities.
Open Truegold/Tempered Truegold table imported.
Open VIP progression table imported; explicit advisory value fields are excluded if present.
Open event scoring table imported as factual progression-event points, not strategy advice.
Major system caps retained from maintained reference.
Lineup strings are tactical recommendations, not factual progression truth.
All eight maintained Database & Charts pages are snapshotted as structured corroborating facts for Gear, Charms, Hero Gear, shards, Mastery, max levels, server timeline and Widgets.
All 33 maintained Event detail pages are source-locked; structured factual tables are retained while narrative strategy/recommendation prose is excluded.

source_gaps.resolution: Do not infer the six rows. Retain the technology identity and wait for an inspectable source table or independently verified in-game evidence.
